integrity: All-parameter proof by explicit cover, cofibration homotopy pushout, and integral Mayer-Vietoris with primitive cycle lattice inclusions. Independent finite mod-two stage and persistence computations for 4 <= m <= 8; these are checks, not substitutes for a proof. No independent external mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for m >= 4 and disjoint matching bridges only; the homotopy splittings are nonequivariant and not chosen coherently with inclusions. The integer homology persistence, not space-level filtration splitting, is classified. The full-matching endpoint was previously known. Publication priority remains provisional.
title: Integral neighborhood homotopy and bridge persistence for partially matched clique pairs
